title: Niagara Falls Pickup: Tour, Boat Ride, Behind the Falls & AeroCar
includes: Entry tickets for the Niagara City Cruises (Hornblower) Boat; replaced with Niagara Flight in winter
Entry tickets for Whirlpool Aero Car; replaced with Skylon Tower in the winter
Round-trip transport from Niagara Falls hotels, with a live tour guide in a small-group van
Entry ticket for Journey Behind the Falls
Optional gratuities for tour guide (not included)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the majestic beauty of Niagara Falls on this small-group tour that includes admission to Niagara's 3 most popular attractions - the Niagara City Cruises (Hornblower) boat ride, Journey Behind the Falls, and a ride on the Whirlpool Aero Car. Your licensed guide will share stories and escort you into the attractions. Enjoy door-to-door transport in a comfortable SUV, with morning and afternoon starting times. 

- Small-group (up to 7) tour for a more personalized experience
- Boat cruise for an up-close view of the falls
- Journey Behind the Falls for amazing photos right next to the biggest falls
- Scenic Aero Car ride offering breathtaking views of the Niagara Whirlpool and its class 6 rapids
- See the International Control Dam, Niagara Whirlpool, Niagara Hydro Power Stations and Floral Clock
- Optional drop off/pick-up at Niagara Helicopters, depending on weather visibility
